abstract: Understanding farm household (FHH) income has been a central concern of agricultural economists and policymakers for more than a century. This review traces the evolution of concepts, definitions, data sources, analytical approaches and empirical evidence used to estimate and compare FHH incomes. It argues that the central measurement challenge is the distinction between the farm business and the FHH. Farm business income is often observable, but household economic welfare depends on total income, income composition, household structure, wealth, liquidity and exposure to volatility. The evidence does not support a simple conclusion that FHHs are universally income‐disadvantaged. In many developed‐country contexts, average income differences narrow or disappear once household size and composition, in‐kind benefits and the choice of comparison group are taken into account. However, income variability, low‐income incidence, distributional outcomes and asset‐rich but cash‐constrained households remain important policy concerns. The review highlights the limits of farm accountancy data for evaluating income‐support objectives and argues for stronger household‐level and linked administrative data systems. Improved measurement is essential for credible policy targeting, transparent evaluation and analysis of FHH well‐being, resilience, generational renewal and social sustainability.
abstract_zh: 理解农户家庭收入一直是农业经济学家和政策制定者一个多世纪以来的核心关注点。本综述追溯了用于估算和比较农户家庭收入的概念、定义、数据来源、分析方法及实证证据的演变过程。文章认为，测量的核心挑战在于区分农业经营实体与农户家庭。农业经营收入通常可观测，但家庭经济福利取决于总收入、收入构成、家庭结构、财富、流动性及面对波动的暴露程度。证据并不支持农户家庭普遍处于收入劣势的简单结论。在许多发达国家情境下，一旦考虑家庭规模和构成、实物福利及比较组的选择，平均收入差距便会缩小或消失。然而，收入波动性、低收入发生率、分配结果以及资产充裕但现金受限的家庭仍是重要的政策关切。本综述强调了农场会计数据在评估收入支持目标方面的局限性，并主张建立更强有力的家庭层面及关联行政数据系统。改进测量对于可信的政策瞄准、透明的评估以及分析农户家庭福祉、韧性、代际更新和社会可持续性至关重要。
title: A Century of Farm Household Income Estimation and Comparison
title_zh: 一个世纪的农户收入估算与比较

abstract: I propose a new imputation estimator for missing covariate values in nonlinear models. The estimator provides efficiency gains relative to just using the complete cases, and is consistent for any model that falls under M‐estimation. This is unlike the commonly used dummy variable method and regression imputation, which I show to be generally inconsistent in nonlinear models. The proposed estimator is straightforward to implement, and relies only on the commonly used assumptions on missingness. To test these assumptions, I provide a novel and simple variable addition test. I show how the framework applies to nonlinear models for fractional and nonnegative responses.
abstract_zh: 我提出了一种新的插补估计量，用于非线性模型中缺失协变量值的处理。该估计量相较于仅使用完整案例的方法能带来效率提升，并且对于任何属于M估计框架的模型均具有一致性。这与常用的虚拟变量方法和回归插补不同，我证明后者在非线性模型中通常不一致。所提出的估计量实施简便，仅依赖于关于缺失性的常用假设。为检验这些假设，我提供了一种新颖且简单的变量添加检验。我展示了该框架如何应用于分数响应和非负响应的非线性模型。
title: Imputing Missing Covariate Values in Nonlinear Models
title_zh: 非线性模型中缺失协变量值的插补

abstract: Suppose that expert witnesses appearing in litigation are, generically, either honest in their assessment of a fact situation or are advocates who testify in favour of their retaining party, regardless of new information. The type of a witness is known to law firms, who engage with them repeatedly, but not to courts. If the only way an honest witness can credibly reveal their type to a court is by agreeing with some of the position of the opposing party, then the question arises of why a law firm would ever retain an honest expert. We show that it can act as a signalling device in a game between the law firms to communicate private information regarding a party's confidence in winning the case. Our results indicate, inter alia, that the “English” rule of costs allocation can make a socially desirable separating equilibrium less likely, compared to the “American” rule.
abstract_zh: 假设在诉讼中出庭的专家证人，大体上可分为两类：一类对其所面对的事实情况评估诚实，另一类则是不论新信息如何，都倾向于为其委托方作证的辩护型证人。律师事务所因与证人反复打交道而知晓其类型，但法院对此并不知情。如果诚实证人能向法院可信地揭示其类型的唯一途径，是部分认同对方当事人的立场，那么问题便产生了：律师事务所为何会聘请诚实专家？我们证明，在律师事务所之间传递关于其案件胜诉信心的私人信息博弈中，这可以作为一种信号机制。我们的研究结果尤其表明，与“美国”规则相比，“英国”的费用分配规则可能使社会期望的分离均衡更难以实现。
title: Of hired guns and ideologues: Why would a law firm ever retain an honest expert witness?
title_zh: 雇佣枪手与意识形态者：律师事务所为何会聘请诚实的专家证人？

abstract: Government regulation of the banking sector is pervasive, making it difficult to empirically analyse when banks would voluntarily choose to issue equity if there were no minimum requirements on capital adequacy. A unique historical setting occurred in the late nineteenth‐century United Kingdom when joint‐stock banks were free to choose their capital structures. We show that during this era, banks were willing to issue equity as part of restructuring processes, but were reluctant to do so on a regular basis to offset increases in liabilities. We find that large issues of uncalled capital were made as a replacement for unlimited liability, and this uncalled capital continued to restrain risk‐taking as shown by an analysis of bank loan books. Banks were also willing to issue stock to finance mergers and acquisitions, but this was generally just used to absorb the equity of target banks so did not increase aggregate paid‐up capital. Equity issuance did not keep pace with deposit growth, leading to the erosion of capital adequacy over the long run.
abstract_zh: 政府对银行业的监管无处不在，这使得在缺乏最低资本充足率要求的情况下，难以实证分析银行何时会自愿选择发行股票。十九世纪末的英国出现了一个独特的历史背景，当时股份制银行可以自由选择其资本结构。我们表明，在那个时代，银行愿意在重组过程中发行股票，但不愿定期这样做以抵消负债的增加。我们发现，大量未缴资本的发行是为了替代无限责任，而这种未缴资本通过银行贷款账簿的分析显示，持续抑制了风险承担。银行也愿意发行股票以资助并购活动，但这通常仅用于吸收目标银行的股权，因此并未增加总实缴资本。股票发行未能跟上存款增长的步伐，导致资本充足率在长期内逐渐侵蚀。
title: Free to choose: Bank capital in Britain, 1878–1939
title_zh: 自由选择：英国银行资本，1878–1939

abstract: Discretionary announcement timing generates high conditional risk premia of stock returns and a pattern of negative drifts followed by positive jumps. Average announcement returns are much larger than unconditional risk premia. Capital Asset Pricing Model alphas turn negative when conditioning on nondisclosure because betas rise faster than risk premia prior to disclosures, but average announcement returns may appear to be too large relative to market risk when betas are estimated from past returns. The effects are amplified when multiple firms exercise discretion over the timing of correlated announcements. We present evidence that firms time earnings announcements in a manner consistent with our model.
abstract_zh: 自主择时公告会产生股票回报的高条件风险溢价，以及负漂移后跟随正跳变的模式。平均公告回报远大于无条件风险溢价。当以未披露为条件时，资本资产定价模型阿尔法值转为负值，因为披露前贝塔值上升速度快于风险溢价，但若贝塔值基于历史回报估计，平均公告回报相对于市场风险可能显得过大。当多家企业对相关公告的时机行使自主权时，这些效应会被放大。我们提供的证据表明，企业选择盈利公告时机的行为与我们的模型一致。
title: Discretionary Announcement Timing and Stock Returns
title_zh: 自主公告时机与股票收益

abstract: This paper examines the relationship between union membership and deaths of despair. Using state-level variation in the timing of the adoption of right-to-work laws as a natural experiment, I show that right-to-work laws are associated with a decline in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair. Two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) difference-in-differences (DiD) estimates suggest that the adoption of a right-to-work law is associated with a 2.6 percentage point reduction in union membership and an increase in deaths of despair mortality of 13 additional persons per 100,000, implying there are approximately 7.5 additional deaths of despair for every 1,000 workers who lose union membership. An analysis of mechanisms suggests the increase in mortality is largely driven by increased opioid usage and a concomitant increase in overdose deaths. I support the TWFE results with estimates from two alternative estimators robust to concerns about treatment effect heterogeneity and variation in treatment timing. Estimates from the Callaway and Sant'Anna (2021) estimator and the Borusyak et al. (2024) estimator support the TWFE findings: right-to-work laws reduce union membership and increase deaths of despair.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了工会会员身份与绝望死亡之间的关系。利用各州采纳工作权法时间上的差异作为自然实验，我表明工作权法与工会会员身份的下降及绝望死亡的增加相关联。双向固定效应（TWFE）双重差分（DiD）估计显示，采纳工作权法与工会会员身份降低2.6个百分点及绝望死亡死亡率每10万人增加13人相关，这意味着每1000名失去工会会员身份的工人中，大约有7.5例额外的绝望死亡。机制分析表明，死亡率的增加主要由阿片类药物使用增加及随之而来的过量死亡增加所驱动。我通过两种对处理效应异质性和处理时间变化具有稳健性的替代估计器来支持TWFE结果。来自Callaway和Sant’Anna（2021）估计器及Borusyak等人（2024）估计器的估计支持TWFE发现：工作权法减少了工会会员身份并增加了绝望死亡。
title: Labor unions and deaths of despair: Evidence from right-to-work laws
title_zh: 工会与绝望之死：来自工作权法的证据

abstract: As the public engagement arm of the land‐grant mission, we argue that Extension faculty in US agricultural economics departments face an identity crossroads as they struggle for institutional support. Specifically, we argue that Extension economists function as boundary‐spanning professionals within academic structures that often devalue applied engagement. Drawing on a 2025 survey of 125 members of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association, this study examines how Extension is defined, practiced, and valued across career stages. Responses indicate broad conceptual agreement that Extension serves as a bridge between research and application, emphasizing stakeholder engagement, decision support, and public communication. However, faculty and graduate students differ in how they frame Extension's institutional role. Graduate students describe it as adaptable and stakeholder‐driven, while faculty anchor it in structured, metric‐based frameworks tied to the Cooperative Extension System. Quantitative and qualitative analyses demonstrate that Extension appointments are perceived as less prestigious than research or research‐teaching roles, exposing persistent status penalties and institutional misalignment in tenure and promotion evaluation. We conclude that current university recognition systems incentivize faculty investments away from Extension and thus require structural changes to advance Extension's part of the tripartite land‐grant mission, particularly in how Extension outputs are evaluated for tenure and promotion.
abstract_zh: 作为土地赠予使命的公共参与分支，我们认为美国农业经济学系的推广教师正面临身份十字路口，因他们在争取机构支持时遭遇困境。具体而言，我们主张推广经济学家在常轻视应用型参与的学术结构中扮演着跨界专业人士的角色。基于2025年对农业与应用经济学协会125名成员的调查，本研究考察了推广在不同职业阶段如何被定义、实践及评价。回应显示，广泛的概念共识认为推广是研究与应用之间的桥梁，强调利益相关者参与、决策支持及公共沟通。然而，教师与研究生在构建推广的机构角色方面存在差异。研究生将其描述为适应性强且以利益相关者为导向，而教师则将其锚定于与合作社推广体系相联系的、基于结构化指标框架之中。定量与定性分析表明，推广职位被视为不如研究或研究-教学职位有声望，揭示了在终身教职与晋升评估中持续存在的地位惩罚及机构错位。我们得出结论，当前大学认可体系激励教师投资偏离推广，因此需要结构性变革以推进推广在土地赠予三重使命中的部分，特别是在终身教职与晋升中如何评估推广成果方面。
title: Extension Economists: Valued in Mission, Penalized in Practice
title_zh: 推广经济学家：使命受重视，实践遭冷遇

abstract: Export bans are frequently used as trade policy instruments to stabilise domestic prices, but they often generate unintended consequences. This study examines the effects of Indonesia's palm oil export ban, introduced in April 2022 and lifted in May 2022, on the performance of the global agricultural sector and the stock markets of palm oil–producing countries. Drawing on a conceptual framework, we develop hypotheses regarding how stock indices with different industrial compositions respond to such trade policy interventions. Using an event study methodology, we analyse daily stock market data from palm oil–producing countries as well as a global agriculture‐specific MSCI index. The analysis encompasses both nationally diversified stock indices and a global sector–specific index. The results reveal statistically significant negative cumulative abnormal returns for the global agricultural index following the introduction of the export ban, whereas national cross‐industry indices show statistically insignificant reactions. Following the lifting of the ban, the global agricultural index experienced statistically significant positive cumulative abnormal returns, whereas national indices exhibited mixed and statistically insignificant responses. These findings are consistent with the conceptual framework, suggesting that the policy primarily affected the global agricultural sector while leaving diversified national stock markets largely unaffected. Importantly, the effects associated with the introduction and subsequent lifting of the ban did not fully offset each other, resulting in an overall negative net effect on the global agricultural index.
abstract_zh: 出口禁令常被用作稳定国内价格的贸易政策工具，但往往会产生意想不到的后果。本研究考察了印度尼西亚于2022年4月实施、2022年5月取消的棕榈油出口禁令对全球农业部门表现及棕榈油生产国股票市场的影响。基于一个概念框架，我们提出了关于不同行业构成的股票指数如何应对此类贸易政策干预的假设。采用事件研究法，我们分析了来自棕榈油生产国的每日股市数据以及一个全球农业特定MSCI指数。分析涵盖了国家层面多元化的股票指数和一个全球行业特定指数。结果显示，出口禁令实施后，全球农业指数出现了统计上显著的负向累积异常收益，而国家跨行业指数则表现出统计上不显著的反应。禁令取消后，全球农业指数经历了统计上显著的正向累积异常收益，而国家指数则表现出混合且统计上不显著的响应。这些发现与概念框架一致，表明该政策主要影响了全球农业部门，而对多元化的国内股票市场影响甚微。重要的是，禁令实施及随后取消所关联的效应并未完全相互抵消，导致全球农业指数整体呈现负的净效应。
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Unravelling the Effects of Indonesia's Oil Palm Export Ban on Global Stock Markets
title_zh: 印尼棕榈油出口禁令对全球股市影响的解析

abstract: We study whether awareness of monitoring or study participation affects racial discrimination. Online participants rated résumés signaling either a Black or White candidate under Control, Monitoring, and Experiment conditions. Across conditions, we unexpectedly find a small average preference for Black résumés, possibly reflecting temporarily heightened racial awareness. The Control condition exhibits greater racial bias in both directions. This pattern suggests that monitoring and awareness of being studied can suppress discriminatory behavior. The findings underscore the importance of credible cover stories in discrimination experiments and indicate that subtle accountability cues may reduce bias in evaluative settings such as hiring.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了监控意识或研究参与是否会影响种族歧视。在线参与者在控制、监控和实验条件下，对表明黑人候选人或白人候选人的简历进行评分。在各条件下，我们意外发现对黑人简历存在轻微的平均偏好，这可能反映了暂时增强的种族意识。控制条件在双向均表现出更大的种族偏见。这一模式表明，监控及被研究的意识可能抑制歧视行为。研究结果强调了在歧视实验中可信掩护故事的重要性，并指出微妙的问责提示可能减少招聘等评估环境中的偏见。
title: Monitoring decreases discrimination
title_zh: 监督减少歧视

abstract: Deforestation in Brazil’s Legal Amazon increased sharply after 2018, renewing concerns about environmental governance and frontier expansion. Yet it remains unclear whether this surge reflected only higher forest loss or a deeper reconfiguration of land-use drivers. The study examines whether the relationships linking municipal deforestation to governance, climate, and agricultural expansion changed after 2018. Using a municipality-year panel covering 634 municipalities for 2010–2021, the study combines satellite-based deforestation data, municipal economic accounts, gridded climate indicators, and environmental enforcement records in panel interaction and event-study models, complemented by an aggregate break-date assessment and spatial comparisons between the arc of deforestation and the interior Amazon. The results are consistent with a post-2018 reconfiguration of deforestation dynamics rather than only an increase in forest-loss levels. After 2018, the already positive enforcement–deforestation association strengthened substantially, indicating a change in magnitude rather than a sign reversal. This pattern is consistent with enforcement actions becoming increasingly concentrated in municipalities under greater deforestation pressure. Baseline estimates suggest that precipitation becomes more positively associated with deforestation while temperature loses explanatory relevance. These climatic shifts are sensitive to specifications that absorb time-varying spatial shocks, while the agricultural channel strengthens mainly outside the consolidated frontier. The baseline estimates are also spatially uneven: precipitation is positively associated with deforestation in the arc but negatively associated in the interior. These findings point to a qualitative restructuring of land-use pressures and support policy responses that combine restored enforcement with spatially differentiated governance strategies.
abstract_zh: 巴西亚马逊合法地区的森林砍伐在2018年后急剧增加，重新引发了关于环境治理和边疆扩张的担忧。然而，尚不清楚这一激增是否仅反映了更高的森林损失，还是土地利用驱动因素发生了更深层次的重组。本研究考察了将市级森林砍伐与治理、气候和农业扩张联系起来的关联在2018年后是否发生了变化。利用覆盖2010—2021年634个市镇的市镇—年度面板数据，本研究将基于卫星的森林砍伐数据、市级经济账户、网格化气候指标和环境执法记录相结合，应用于面板交互和事件研究模型中，并辅以总体断点日期评估以及砍伐弧区与亚马逊内陆之间的空间比较。结果与2018年后森林砍伐动态的重组相一致，而非仅仅是森林损失水平的上升。2018年后，原本已为正的执法—森林砍伐关联显著增强，表明变化体现在幅度而非符号反转上。这一模式与执法行动日益集中于面临更大砍伐压力的市镇相一致。基线估计表明，降水与森林砍伐的正向关联增强，而温度的解释相关性减弱。这些气候效应在吸收时变空间冲击的设定下较为敏感，而农业渠道主要在已整合边疆之外得到强化。基线估计在空间上也不均衡：在砍伐弧区，降水与森林砍伐呈正相关，而在内陆地区则呈负相关。这些发现指向土地利用压力的质性重构，并支持将恢复执法与空间差异化治理策略相结合的政策应对。
title: Reconfiguring deforestation drivers in Brazil’s Legal Amazon after 2018: Climate, agricultural production, and environmental governance
title_zh: 2018年后巴西亚马逊合法区毁林驱动因素的重构：气候、农业生产与环境治理

abstract: We investigate the effects of trade secret (TS) protection on supplier exclusivity in vertical industrial relations. We show that manufacturers limit their suppliers’ buyer networks under weak TS protection to safeguard sensitive information while encouraging supplier investment. Using worldwide automotive parts contracts data, we find that weak TS protection constrains suppliers to serve only a few Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), sometimes leading to exclusivity, especially for parts with intermediate relationship-specificity. This association strengthens with greater OEM bargaining power, aligning with theoretical insights. We validate these findings by examining supplier attributes, including size, cartel involvement, and ownership structure. F23, O34, L14, L24, L62
abstract_zh: 我们研究了商业秘密（TS）保护对纵向产业关系中供应商排他性的影响。研究表明，在商业秘密保护较弱的情况下，制造商为保护敏感信息而限制供应商的客户网络，同时鼓励供应商进行投资。利用全球汽车零部件合同数据，我们发现，薄弱的商业秘密保护约束了供应商仅服务于少数原始设备制造商（OEMs），有时甚至导致排他性，尤其对于关系特定性中等的零部件而言。这一关联随着OEM议价能力的增强而加强，与理论见解相符。我们通过考察供应商特征（包括规模、卡特尔参与情况及所有权结构）验证了这些发现。F23, O34, L14, L24, L62
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Exclusive Secrets,
title_zh: 独家秘密，

abstract: Supply uncertainty, characterized by stochastic lead times and random supply quantities, has attracted increasing attention from academia, industries, and governments, particularly in the aftermath of the COVID-19 pandemic. In this paper, we consider the problem of managing lost-sales inventory systems with general supply uncertainty: stochastic lead times and random supplies. Unlike the previous studies, we assume the decision maker has no prior information on the stochastic demand and supply. We propose the first provably effective learning algorithm for inventory management problems with censored demand and supply data under general supply uncertainty. Then, we establish a cumulative regret of [Formula: see text] for this learning algorithm compared with the best constant-order policy, where [Formula: see text] is the upper bound of the random part, and L is the deterministic part of the stochastic lead times. We also conduct numerical experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of our algorithm. Our approach lies in developing a new framework for transformed convexity. Furthermore, we address the unique challenges of our problem through new techniques, for example, estimating the long-run cost by establishing coupling and concentration results utilizing the system structures. These techniques are also of independent interest. Beyond our problem, our framework provides broad implications for other operations management (OM) problems exhibiting transformed convexity. abstract: We examine the value of skilled immigrants in finance by exploiting evidence from visa lotteries. We find that hedge fund management companies that secure more H-1B visas in random lotteries deliver higher alphas, Sharpe ratios, and information ratios. The superior performance of funds with high H-1B visa allocations can be attributed to well-paid and highly educated H-1B workers with quantitative skills. H-1B workers add value by helping hedge funds develop distinctive investment strategies, arbitrage prominent stock anomalies, and overcome capacity constraints. Hedge funds appear to exploit labor market frictions as alpha generation is greatest by workers from countries with the longest wait times for U.S. permanent residency. This paper was accepted by Lukas Schmid, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07615 .

abstract: Traders devote significant resources to producing private information. The value of such information is eroded when it is leaked. We study the use of multiple brokers by institutions to help mitigate information leakage. We document that trades using multiple brokers better predict future returns and have higher future profits, consistent with information possessed by investors driving the decision to use multiple brokers. We find that trades using multiple brokers are more informed and, yet, have lower price impacts, lower implementation shortfalls, and fewer follower trades than similar single-broker trades. The results suggest that traders use multiple brokers to successfully reduce information leakage. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. abstract_zh: 交易者投入大量资源以生成私有信息。此类信息的价值在泄露时便会受损。我们研究了机构使用多家经纪商以帮助减轻信息泄露的情况。我们记录到，使用多家经纪商的交易能更好地预测未来收益，并带来更高的未来利润，这与投资者所掌握的信息驱动其选择多家经纪商的决定相一致。我们发现，使用多家经纪商的交易更具信息含量，然而，与相似的单经纪商交易相比，其价格影响更低、执行缺口更小，且跟随交易者更少。这些结果表明，交易者利用多家经纪商成功减少了信息泄露。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融领域）接受。补充材料：网络附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201 获取。

abstract: This paper investigates how environmental regulatory uncertainty affects green innovation in polluting firms. The findings suggest that, instead of adopting a passive “wait-and-see” strategy, polluting firms proactively engage in green innovation and R&D activities. To address endogeneity, I employ an instrumental variable approach using political polarization in roll-call votes on environmental and climate issues in the U.S. House of Representatives. I also exploit the proposal of the Affordable Clean Energy rule in 2018 as an exogenous shock in a difference-in-differences framework. The results are consistent with the growth options view of green innovation in polluting firms. Additional evidence suggests that environmental regulatory uncertainty leads to reductions in toxic emissions. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. abstract: Do job seekers consider the race or gender of an employer when applying for a job? Although we have extensive research on employer-side discrimination, we know less about employee-side biases and their consequences. In this study, we examine how the gender and race of the employer shape the willingness of prospective employees to apply for a job. To examine this, we conducted a field experiment where we randomized real jobseekers into three conditions according to employer demographics. We find that job candidates were less likely to apply to a job when they learn that the founders are Black, and, when they did apply, they requested 10% higher salary. In addition, the more qualified a candidate, the less likely they were to apply to Black founders, leaving Black founders with a pool of candidates that is smaller, worse, and more expensive than their White peers. We find no gender penalty for White female founders. Findings from two survey experiments suggest that the penalty is unique to White applicants evaluating Black founders and reflects a concern among White applicants that they will be less likely to fit within a firm and that the firm is less likely to be successful in the long run. We find no evidence of a widespread applicant homophily where all applicants favor founders of their own ethnic group, nor do we find evidence of widespread statistical discrimination whereby all applicants penalize Black founders for being atypical members of the entrepreneurial class. This paper was accepted by Olav Sorenson, organizations. Funding: Financial support from the INSEAD Alumni Fund is gratefully acknowledged. abstract_zh: 求职者在申请工作时，是否会考虑雇主的种族或性别？尽管关于雇主方歧视的研究已相当丰富，但我们对雇员方偏见及其后果知之甚少。本研究探讨了雇主的性别和种族如何影响潜在求职者的申请意愿。为此，我们开展了一项实地实验，根据雇主的人口统计特征，将真实求职者随机分配到三种情境中。研究发现，当求职者得知创始人为黑人时，他们申请该职位的可能性较低；即便申请，他们要求的薪资也高出10%。此外，候选人资质越高，申请黑人创始人职位的可能性越低，这导致黑人创始人面临的候选人群体规模更小、质量更差且成本更高，与白人创始人相比处于劣势。我们未发现白人女性创始人面临性别惩罚。两项调查实验的结果表明，这种惩罚仅出现在白人求职者评估黑人创始人时，反映出白人求职者担心自己在该公司难以融入，且认为该公司长期成功的可能性较低。我们未发现广泛的求职者同质性偏好，即所有求职者都偏向于同族裔创始人；也未发现广泛的统计性歧视，即所有求职者因黑人创始人是创业者阶层中的非典型成员而对其施加惩罚。本文由组织领域编辑Olav Sorenson接受。资金支持：感谢欧洲工商管理学院校友基金提供的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2021.00481获取。

abstract: We study a newsvendor problem with unknown demand distribution in a nonstationary demand environment over a multiperiod time horizon. The demand in each period consists of a time-varying demand level and an additive random shock. Neither the demand level nor the random shock is separately observable. The amount of change in the demand level over the time horizon is measured by a cumulative variation metric. The problem has widespread applications, such as perishable inventory planning, staffing, and medical resource capacity planning in the wake of COVID-19. We design a family of nonparametric dynamic ordering policies, termed two-stage estimation (2SE) policies, that track the shifts in the unknown demand level while accounting for the unobservable random demand shocks. To compute the order quantity in each period, these policies only need the past demand observations, without any access to the underlying demand distribution. For a finite variation “budget,” we prove that our ordering policies are first-order optimal in the sense that their regret grows at the smallest possible rate. We also extend our analysis to the case of asymptotically large variation budgets. Through case studies based on real-life data, we show that our policies can save more than 20% of overage and underage costs, relative to policies widely used for perishable inventory replenishment and nurse staffing. Moreover, our simulation experiments indicate that our policies consistently maintain superior performance across diverse patterns of nonstationary demand environments. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management. Funding: N. B. Keskin and J.-S. Song were supported by the Duke University Fuqua School of Business, and X. Min was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China [Grant 72401195] and the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation [2025T180216]. abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个在非平稳需求环境下，多期时间范围内需求分布未知的报童问题。每期的需求由时变的需求水平与加性随机冲击构成，而需求水平与随机冲击均无法单独观测。需求水平随时间变化的幅度通过累积变化度量来衡量。该问题具有广泛的应用背景，如易腐品库存规划、人员配置以及新冠疫情背景下的医疗资源容量规划。我们设计了一族非参数动态订货策略，称为两阶段估计策略，该策略在考虑不可观测的随机需求冲击的同时，追踪未知需求水平的变化。这些策略在计算每期订货量时，仅需历史需求观测数据，无需接触潜在的需求分布。对于有限的变化“预算”，我们证明了所提出的订货策略在遗憾值以最小可能速率增长的意义下是一阶最优的。我们还将分析扩展至渐近大变化预算的情形。基于真实数据的案例研究表明，与广泛用于易腐品库存补货和护士配置的策略相比，我们的策略能节省超过20%的超储与缺货成本。此外，模拟实验表明，我们的策略在多样化的非平稳需求环境模式下始终保持优越性能。本文由David Simchi-Levi负责运营管理方向审阅。资金支持：N. abstract: Conservation covenants are an innovative legal mechanism that modify private property rights to promote biodiversity benefits. Their use is increasing as governments encourage private land conservation to help meet national and global biodiversity goals, such as the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. However, existing use of covenants from a variety of countries, including Australia, New Zealand and the United States, highlights some limitations. There is limited explicit accommodation of changing circumstances such as climate impacts; insufficient support to landowners and a need for increased environmental monitoring and compliance oversight. Several actions could be taken to ameliorate these and other law-related impediments, including improved reciprocity between parties to covenants, designing covenants with greater flexibility, and improving integrity mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 保护契约是一种创新的法律机制，通过调整私人财产权以促进生物多样性效益。随着政府鼓励私人土地保护以助力实现国家和全球生物多样性目标，如昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架，其应用日益增多。然而，来自澳大利亚、新西兰和美国等多个国家的现有契约使用情况揭示了若干局限性。这些包括对气候变化影响等变化情况的明确适应不足；对土地所有者的支持不够，以及需要加强环境监测和合规监督。为缓解这些及其他法律相关障碍，可采取多项措施，包括增强契约双方间的互惠性，设计更具灵活性的契约，以及完善诚信机制。

abstract: Housing inequalities have long been a pressing global issue, particularly in the context of rapidly transforming urban housing markets. However, intra-urban spatiotemporal disparities in housing price dynamics remain insufficiently understood. By developing an infrastructural approach operationalized through interpretable machine-learning methods that explicitly incorporate spatiotemporal heterogeneity, this study examines the complex capitalization of key infrastructures into housing prices, drawing on 288,570 second-hand housing transactions and multi-source geographic data from 2010 to 2023 in Shenzhen, one of the largest and most dynamic urban housing markets in China. The results reveal increasingly intensified housing price disparities, which are particularly pronounced within school catchment areas and 15-minute infrastructure-accessible neighborhoods. Compared with physical infrastructures, as well as structural and locational attributes, social infrastructures—especially public schools—are more decisively and consistently associated with housing prices. Their spatiotemporally heterogenous capitalization and increasingly salient threshold effects highlight the agency of social infrastructures in leveraging urban development and (re)shaping social inequalities, thereby advancing the understanding of housing price disparities. Finally, this study provides dynamic, fine-grained evidence to support locally calibrated and stage-sensitive urban planning and housing policies.
abstract_zh: 住房不平等长期以来一直是全球性的紧迫问题，尤其是在城市住房市场快速转型的背景下。然而，城市内部住房价格动态的时空差异仍未得到充分理解。通过构建一种基础设施分析方法，并借助可解释的机器学习方法明确纳入时空异质性，本研究考察了关键基础设施对住房价格的复杂资本化效应，基于2010年至2023年间深圳288,570笔二手房交易及多源地理数据进行分析。深圳是中国规模最大、最具活力的城市住房市场之一。研究结果显示，住房价格差异日益加剧，尤其是在学区范围内和15分钟基础设施可达的邻里区域表现尤为突出。与实体基础设施以及结构和区位属性相比，社会基础设施——尤其是公立学校——与住房价格的关系更为决定性和一致性。其时空异质性的资本化效应及日益显著的阈值效应，凸显了社会基础设施在推动城市发展和（重新）塑造社会不平等中的能动作用，从而深化了对住房价格差异的理解。最后，本研究提供了动态、精细化的证据，以支持因地制宜、分阶段响应的城市规划和住房政策。

abstract: Urban green spaces (UGSs) in rapidly urbanizing African cities are increasingly threatened by weak governance systems and institutional inefficiencies. This study investigates how formal and informal institutional arrangements shape governance responsibilities, interagency coordination, and UGS management in the Greater Tamale Metropolitan Area, Ghana. Using an institutional theory framework, the research adopted a qualitative case study approach, involving 54 semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and field observations across selected communities: Sagnarigu, Nyohini, Gumbeheni, Taha, and Kukuo. The findings reveal that UGS governance in Tamale operates through a hybrid institutional system in which statutory planning frameworks coexist with customary land tenure systems. Traditional authorities, particularly chiefs, play a significant role in land allocation and initiating planning processes, while state institutions primarily provide regulatory oversight. Although this arrangement creates opportunities for legitimacy and local participation, it also generates ambiguities in authority, weak accountability, and poor coordination among stakeholders. Collaboration tends to be stronger within institutional groupings than between local actors and formal spatial planning institutions. The study further identifies critical institutional constraints, including overlapping mandates, limited public participation, and severe staffing shortages in planning and environmental agencies. Specifically, only one of the required five physical planning officers and one of the four required development control officers were available during the study period. These institutional weaknesses, compounded by rapid urbanization and increasing land-use pressures, contribute significantly to the decline of UGS. The study concludes that strengthening coordination, accountability, participation, and institutional capacity is essential for sustainable and inclusive UGS governance.
abstract_zh: 非洲快速城市化城市中的城市绿地（UGS）日益受到治理体系薄弱和制度效率低下的威胁。本研究探讨正式与非正式制度安排如何塑造加纳大塔马利都市区的治理责任、机构间协调及城市绿地管理。基于制度理论框架，研究采用定性案例研究方法，在选定的社区——萨格纳里古、尼奥希尼、贡贝赫尼、塔哈和库库奥——开展了54次半结构化访谈、文件分析和实地观察。研究发现，塔马利的城市绿地治理运行于一种混合制度体系中，法定规划框架与习惯土地保有制度并存。传统权威，尤其是酋长，在土地分配和启动规划进程中发挥重要作用，而国家机构主要提供监管监督。尽管这一安排为合法性和地方参与创造了机会，但也导致了权威模糊、问责薄弱以及利益相关者之间协调不力。协作在制度群体内部往往强于地方行动者与正式空间规划机构之间。研究进一步识别了关键制度制约因素，包括职责重叠、公众参与有限以及规划与环境机构严重的人员短缺。具体而言，在研究期间，所需五名实体规划官员中仅有一名到位，所需四名开发控制官员中也仅有一名在岗。这些制度弱点，加之快速城市化和日益增长的土地利用压力，显著加剧了城市绿地的退化。研究得出结论，加强协调、问责、参与和制度能力对于可持续和包容性的城市绿地治理至关重要。
title: Institutional relationships in urban green space governance in Greater Tamale, Ghana: Roles, interactions and policy implications for sustainable management

abstract: Global climate change and extreme precipitation events pose increasing threats to agricultural systems worldwide. However, existing studies often fail to integrate the synergistic effects of precipitation, neglect the role of transportation infrastructure, and rely on data with coarse spatial resolution. To address these gaps, this study develops a “climate–cropland–transportation” framework. By integrating high-resolution hourly precipitation data (0.1˚) and 30 m cropland distribution data, we quantified the thresholds, frequency, and intensity of extreme precipitation to construct a Cropland Extreme Precipitation Exposure ( CEPE ) index using the entropy weighting method. Four transportation accessibility scenarios—considering the presence or absence of expressways connecting prefecture- and county-level cities—were simulated to examine their spatial coupling with the CEPE . The results reveal pronounced spatial heterogeneity in CEPE across the study area. Rural population density and industrial structure exert nonlinear regulatory effects on cropland exposure to extreme precipitation. Extreme precipitation intensity peaks at moderate population levels, while areas where the primary industry accounts for 30–40% of the economy constitute a critical buffering zone. Geographically, croplands in southwest China remain highly threatened by extreme precipitation, whereas the exposure fluctuates considerably across the Huang–Huai–Hai Plain and the Northeast China Plain. Uneven transportation accessibility further amplifies these exposures, creating vulnerability traps in regions with high exposure but low accessibility, such as the Northeast China Plain. These findings offer valuable insights for developing targeted agricultural and infrastructure strategies to strengthen agricultural resilience under climate extremes.
abstract_zh: 全球气候变化与极端降水事件对全球农业系统构成日益严重的威胁。然而，现有研究往往未能整合降水的协同效应，忽视了交通基础设施的作用，且依赖空间分辨率较粗的数据。为弥补上述不足，本研究构建了“气候—农田—交通”分析框架。通过整合高分辨率逐时降水数据（0.1˚）与30米农田分布数据，量化了极端降水的阈值、频率和强度，并采用熵权法构建了农田极端降水暴露度（CEPE）指数。本研究模拟了四种交通可达性情景——考虑地级市与县级市之间高速公路的有无——以考察其与CEPE的空间耦合关系。结果表明，研究区域内CEPE呈现显著的空间异质性。农村人口密度与产业结构对农田极端降水暴露度产生非线性调节效应。极端降水强度在中等人口水平下达到峰值，而第一产业占经济比重30%—40%的地区构成关键缓冲地带。从地理分布看，中国西南地区农田仍面临极端降水的高度威胁，而黄淮海平原和东北平原的暴露度则波动较大。交通可达性的不均衡进一步加剧了上述暴露风险，在高暴露但低可达性的地区（如东北平原）形成了脆弱性陷阱。上述发现为制定针对性的农业与基础设施策略、增强气候极端事件下的农业韧性提供了有价值的参考。

abstract: With booming global trade and deepened connectivity, China, a central player in global oilseed trade networks, has not only eased domestic supply shortages but also fundamentally reshaped global resource allocation. However, the specific impacts of this trade on the quantity and quality of cultivated land protection remain under-explored. Using complex network analysis under the metacoupling framework, this study examines the evolution of major oilseed trade patterns from 2010 to 2023 and their metacoupling impacts. During 2010–2023, the global oilseed trade network exhibited escalating structural tightness and localized clustering, evidenced by a 27.2% and 24.6% increase in network density for the S1 and S2 networks, respectively, alongside a notable transition from regional fragmentation to transcontinental integration. Crucially, China’s oilseed imports activate a "Dual-track Land Sparing Mechanism": quantitatively expanding global land savings from 116.4 to 193.1 M ha, while qualitatively buffering the domestic agricultural system by trade-driven shifts in cultivation patterns, thereby stabilizing China’s domestic cultivated land pressure index at a low safety margin (0.13–0.16). This study highlights the pivotal role of trade in balancing national food security with global sustainable land management. Future policies should focus on diversifying import sources to sustain these quantity-quality benefits against supply concentration risks.
abstract_zh: 随着全球贸易蓬勃发展和互联互通不断深化，中国作为全球油籽贸易网络的核心参与者，不仅缓解了国内供应短缺问题，也从根本上重塑了全球资源配置格局。然而，这一贸易对耕地保护数量与质量的具体影响仍未得到充分探讨。本研究在元耦合框架下运用复杂网络分析，考察了2010年至2023年主要油籽贸易格局的演变及其元耦合效应。2010—2023年间，全球油籽贸易网络呈现出结构紧密度上升和局部集聚增强的特征，S1和S2网络的网络密度分别增长了27.2%和24.6%，同时呈现出从区域碎片化向跨大陆一体化转变的显著趋势。至关重要的是，中国油籽进口激活了“双轨土地节约机制”：在数量层面，全球土地节约规模从1.164亿公顷扩大至1.931亿公顷；在质量层面，通过贸易驱动的种植模式转变，对国内农业系统形成缓冲，从而将中国国内耕地压力指数稳定在较低安全区间（0.13—0.16）。本研究凸显了贸易在平衡国家粮食安全与全球可持续土地管理中的关键作用。未来政策应聚焦于进口来源多元化，以在供应集中风险下维持上述数量—质量双重效益。

abstract: The spatiotemporal patterns of land consolidation in China have undergone profound reshaping, exerting significant impacts on socioeconomic development. Based on land use data from 2000 to 2024, this study analyzes the multi-scale spatiotemporal evolution and multidimensional effects of Chin’s land consolidation from the two dimensions of quantity and quality, specifically through cultivated land conversion area and cultivated land fragmentation. Significant spatial heterogeneity is identified. Four governance modes emerge: a "high-quantity-high-quality" synergistic improvement in the Northeast Plain; a coexistence of "high-quantity-low-quality" in the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau; a "low-quantity-high-quality" optimization in the Huang-Huai-Hai Plain; and a "low-quantity-low-quality" lag in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. Markov-chain forecasts indicate that cultivated land conversion is mobile under policy intervention and spatial spillovers, whereas cultivated land fragmentation remains rigid and stable due to natural constraints and spatial lock-in. Using the High-Standard Farmland Construction Policy as a quasi-natural experiment, land consolidation is found to have significantly increased grain production capacity and agricultural net carbon sequestration, while its effects on land transfer exhibit marked regional heterogeneity. Stronger policy responses in yield improvement and carbon-sink gains are observed in central western regions and major grain-producing areas, whereas land-transfer markets in eastern China are more sensitive to policy shocks. The study provides systematic empirical evidence for improving territorial-spatial governance and offers China’s experience to global sustainable land management.
abstract_zh: 中国土地整治的时空格局经历了深刻重塑，对社会经济发展产生了显著影响。基于2000—2024年土地利用数据，本研究从数量与质量两个维度，即通过耕地转换面积与耕地破碎度，分析了中国土地整治的多尺度时空演变及其多维效应。研究发现显著的空间异质性。四种治理模式浮现：东北平原的“高数量—高质量”协同提升；云贵高原的“高数量—低质量”并存；黄淮海平原的“低数量—高质量”优化；以及青藏高原的“低数量—低质量”滞后。马尔可夫链预测表明，在政策干预与空间溢出作用下，耕地转换具有流动性，而耕地破碎度因自然约束与空间锁定效应而保持刚性与稳定。以高标准农田建设政策为准自然实验，研究发现土地整治显著提升了粮食生产能力与农业净碳汇，而其土地流转效应则呈现显著的区域异质性。中西部地区及粮食主产区在增产与碳汇增益方面表现出更强的政策响应，而东部地区土地流转市场对政策冲击更为敏感。本研究为完善国土空间治理提供了系统性经验证据，并为全球可持续土地管理贡献了中国经验。

abstract: Firms often expose themselves to currency risk by borrowing in foreign currencies, even when the local currency actually provides a better hedge in downturns. Motivated by this novel fact, we develop an international corporate finance model in which firms facing adverse selection choose the foreign currency share of their debt. In the unique separating equilibrium, good firms optimally expose themselves to currency risk to signal their type. Crucially, the nature of this equilibrium depends on the co-movement between cash flows and the exchange rate. We provide evidence consistent with the predictions of the model using a granular dataset including more than 4800 firms in 19 emerging markets and 5700 firms in 22 advanced economies between 2005 and 2021. The signaling mechanism is most salient for firms in emerging markets and also those subject to greater information asymmetries in advanced economies. These findings are important for assessing and managing risks from currency mismatches on corporate balance sheets.
abstract_zh: 企业常常通过借入外币来暴露自身于汇率风险之中，即便本币在经济下行期实际上能提供更好的对冲效果。受这一新颖事实启发，我们构建了一个国际企业金融模型，在该模型中，面临逆向选择的企业会选择其债务中外币所占的比例。在唯一的分离均衡中，优质企业会最优地选择暴露于汇率风险以传递其类型信号。关键在于，这一均衡的性质取决于现金流与汇率之间的联动关系。我们利用一个包含2005年至2021年间19个新兴市场超过4800家企业及22个发达经济体5700家企业的精细数据集，提供了与模型预测相一致的证据。信号机制在新兴市场的企业中最为显著，同时也在发达经济体中面临更大信息不对称的企业中表现突出。这些发现对于评估和管理企业资产负债表上货币错配风险具有重要意义。
title: Signaling with debt currency choice
title_zh: 债务货币选择中的信号传递

abstract: As shortages of resources like water and electricity due to extreme weather events become more frequent, high prices alone may fail to curb demand, making shortages more common. We examine a power limit policy for residential electricity households that rations electricity consumption rather than setting it to zero, as in a traditional rolling blackout. We find that power limits can provide equivalent savings to large blackouts, even when generous. Additionally, due to selection, power limits reduce the number of households affected by a shortage event. We conclude by discussing the welfare consequences of power limits and their heterogeneous impact across households. abstract_zh: 随着关键资源短缺日益频繁，仅靠高价格可能无法有效抑制需求。我们研究了居民用电的功率限制，这种限制约束家庭消费，而非像轮流停电那样将消费降至零。我们从理论和实证两方面证明，功率限制能够实现相当于大规模停电的节电效果，同时影响到的家庭数量更少。其机制在于对高用电量用户的选择性作用，这产生了分配上的权衡，取决于限制是统一设定还是按合同功率比例设定。这凸显了智能电表在改善短缺管理的同时，保障基本电力服务可及性的潜力。
title: Smart power limits: Designing shortage mechanisms for extreme events
title_zh: 智能电力限制：极端事件下的短缺机制设计

abstract: Behavioral nudges in the form of peer-comparison information have, in many cases, proven effective in promoting pro-social behavior. The most prominent example is the use of home energy reports in electricity markets. While there is evidence that peer comparisons can induce reductions in externality-generating consumption, it is not clear through which channels the nudges operate. One possible channel is pecuniary: peer comparisons may make consumption choices more salient and prompt discovery of opportunities for financial savings. The other is non-pecuniary: peer comparisons may trigger moral motives such as guilt, social conformism, or social competitiveness. This study uses a controlled posted-price market experiment with externalities. We eliminate the “discovery” channel present in field settings by making financial incentives fixed and known. The experiment thus controls the pecuniary channel, leaving only the non-pecuniary, “moral” channel. We find that the nudge still enhances pro-social behavior, pointing to the moral channel’s importance. Two additional findings are that the nudge is equally effective across the treatments with low and high market prices (indicating that nudges and financial incentives neither complement nor crowd each other out) and that the nudge is more effective for participants with relatively cooperative worldviews.
abstract_zh: 以同伴比较信息为形式的行为助推，在许多情况下已被证明能有效促进亲社会行为。最显著的例子是电力市场中家庭能源报告的使用。尽管有证据表明同伴比较能诱导减少产生外部性的消费，但助推发挥作用的具体渠道尚不明确。一种可能的渠道是金钱性的：同伴比较可能使消费选择更加突出，并促使人们发现节省财务开支的机会。另一种是非金钱性的：同伴比较可能触发道德动机，如内疚感、社会从众心理或社会竞争意识。本研究采用带有外部性的受控标价市场实验。我们通过使财务激励固定且已知，消除了实地环境中存在的“发现”渠道。因此，该实验控制了金钱性渠道，仅保留非金钱性的“道德”渠道。我们发现，助推仍然增强了亲社会行为，这表明道德渠道的重要性。另外两项发现是：助推在低市场价格和高市场价格处理中效果相同（表明助推与财务激励既不相辅相成，也不相互排斥），且助推对世界观相对合作的参与者更为有效。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Peer comparisons and the cost of pro-social behavior: Evidence from the lab
title_zh: 同伴比较与亲社会行为的成本：来自实验室的证据

abstract: We estimate productivity spillovers from Japanese cotton-spinning firms in China (known as Zaikabo) to local Chinese cotton-spinning mills based on plant-level data for 1925 to 1938. In order to capture the important role of distance in facilitating such spillovers we geo-localised the plants. Our results provide clear evidence for positive spillovers from Zaikabo to local Chinese mills, which go hand-in-hand with an upgrade in production technology towards greater use of capital. Spillovers are very localised, being strongest within a radius of up to 10 km around the Zaikabo and particularly strong for mills in Shanghai. Exploiting information on the workforce composition of the Japanese affiliates, we find suggestive evidence of a skilled-labour channel: spillovers tend to be larger from Zaikabo employing higher shares of skilled labour. We also find some evidence in line with the idea that these gains are larger for Chinese mills with higher initial productivity, consistent with a role for absorptive capacity. Our paper is the first to document FDI productivity spillovers in a historical context and to characterise the channels through which they operate.
abstract_zh: 我们基于1925年至1938年的工厂层面数据，估算了日本在华棉纺企业（即“在华纺”）对本地中国棉纺厂的生产率溢出效应。为捕捉距离在促进此类溢出中的重要作用，我们对工厂进行了地理定位。研究结果清晰表明，在华纺对本地中国棉纺厂存在正向溢出效应，且这些效应伴随着生产技术向资本更密集使用的升级。溢出效应具有高度本地化特征，在华纺周围10公里半径内最为显著，尤其在上海的棉纺厂中表现突出。利用日本附属企业劳动力构成的信息，我们发现了技能劳动力渠道的提示性证据：雇佣技能劳动力比例较高的在华纺，其溢出效应往往更大。我们还发现一些证据支持这些收益对中国初始生产率较高的棉纺厂更为显著，这与吸收能力的作用相符。本文首次在历史背景下记录了外商直接投资的生产率溢出效应，并刻画了其作用渠道。

abstract: Stablecoins are cryptoassets designed to be pegged to the dollar, but they are backed by imperfectly liquid USD assets. We show that stablecoins feature concentrated arbitrage: the largest issuer, Tether, allows only six agents in an average month to redeem stablecoins for cash. We argue that the issuers’ choice of arbitrage concentration reflects a trade-off: efficient arbitrage improves stablecoin price stability in secondary markets but amplifies run risks by reducing investors’ price impact from selling stablecoins. Our findings imply that policies designed to improve stablecoin price stability may have the unintended consequence of increasing stablecoin run risks. (JEL G01, G23)
abstract_zh: 稳定币是一种旨在与美元挂钩的加密资产，但其背后支撑的是流动性不完全的美元资产。我们研究表明，稳定币具有集中的套利特征：最大的发行方Tether，在平均每月仅允许六个代理将稳定币兑换为现金。我们认为，发行方对套利集中度的选择反映了一种权衡：高效的套利能提升稳定币在二级市场的价格稳定性，但通过降低投资者出售稳定币时的价格冲击，反而加剧了挤兑风险。我们的发现意味着，旨在改善稳定币价格稳定性的政策可能带来增加稳定币挤兑风险的意外后果。（JEL G01, G23）
title: Stablecoin Runs and the Centralization of Arbitrage
title_zh: 稳定币挤兑与套利活动的中心化

abstract: Abstract Motivated by the introduction of digital services taxes (DSTs) in several European countries and the widespread use of revenue-based taxes where profit taxation is imperfect, this paper studies whether targeted output or commodity taxes can serve as surrogate profit taxes when firms avoid corporate taxation – such as by shifting profits to low-tax jurisdictions. The answer is a qualified yes. Output taxation of tax-avoiding firms is optimal when the resulting reduction in output mitigates tax avoidance. I derive an augmented inverse-elasticity rule showing that the optimal output tax decreases with the demand elasticity (as in the classic Ramsey rule) but increases with the output elasticity of profit shifting and the degree of foreign firm ownership. When nonlinear labor income taxation is available, zero output taxation arises only under restrictive ownership conditions – namely, identical ownership shares across household types and full domestic ownership of firms – which are unlikely to hold in practice, particularly in open European economies. In these cases, the optimal tax system combines distortionary profit taxes with non-uniform output taxes. Finally, I establish a complementarity theorem: Whenever the optimal tax system includes a distortionary profit tax, output taxes are also part of the optimal policy mix. These results provide a welfare-based perspective on the role of DSTs as second-best instruments in environments characterized by profit shifting and international ownership.
abstract_zh: 受欧洲多国引入数字服务税（DSTs）以及利润税不完善环境下普遍采用基于收入的税收的启发，本文研究当企业规避公司税——例如通过将利润转移至低税率辖区——时，针对性的产出税或商品税能否作为利润税的替代工具。答案是有限度的肯定。当对避税企业征收产出税能通过减少产出而缓解避税行为时，此类税收即为最优。我推导出一个增强的逆弹性法则，表明最优产出税随需求弹性下降（如同经典拉姆齐法则），但随利润转移的产出弹性及外国企业所有权程度上升而增加。当非线性劳动所得税可用时，零产出税仅在严格的所有权条件下成立——即各家庭类型间所有权份额相同且企业完全由国内所有——这些条件在实践中难以满足，尤其在开放的欧洲经济体中。在这些情况下，最优税收体系结合了扭曲性利润税与非统一的产出税。最后，我确立了一个互补性定理：只要最优税收体系包含扭曲性利润税，产出税也必然是最优政策组合的一部分。这些结果为DSTs在利润转移和国际所有权环境中的次优工具角色提供了基于福利的视角。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: When are digital services taxes optimal? Output taxes and profit shifting
title_zh: 数字服务税何时最优？产出税与利润转移

abstract: This paper studies social choice rules over sets of feasible utility vectors à la Nash’s (1950) bargaining problem. First, we identify necessary and sufficient conditions for choice rules to be rationalized by welfare orderings or functions over 0–1 normalized utility vectors. These general results are useful for providing an axiomatic foundation for a novel class of choice rules with normalization. Furthermore, we show that at the axiomatic level, this class of choice rules is closely related to the classical bargaining solution introduced by Kalai and Smorodinsky (1975).
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一类社会选择规则，其对象为可行效用向量集合，遵循纳什（1950）讨价还价问题的框架。首先，我们识别了选择规则能够被0-1标准化效用向量上的福利排序或函数合理化的必要且充分条件。这些一般性结果有助于为带有标准化处理的新型选择规则类别提供公理化基础。此外，我们表明，在公理层面，这类选择规则与卡拉伊和斯莫罗丁斯基（1975）提出的经典讨价还价解密切相关。
title: Social choice rules when individuals are responsible for their skills
title_zh: 当个体对其技能负责时的社会选择规则

abstract: We study a bargaining model where a distributor allocates new users between an incumbent supplier, which also serves an installed base, and a rival. We compare separable agreements, whereby installed-base payments continue regardless of the new-user award, with platform-wide agreements, whereby those payments are made only if the incumbent receives the award. When installed-base users are inframarginal and bargaining is frictionless, the contractual linkage does not affect supplier selection or the rival’s equilibrium payment: the distributor’s lost payment is exactly offset by the incumbent’s avoided payment. When contracting frictions are present, platform-wide agreements can exclude a more efficient rival.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个议价模型，其中分销商将新用户分配给一个既服务现有客户群的在位供应商，或其竞争对手。我们比较了可分离协议与平台范围协议，前者无论新用户归属如何，现有客户群的支付都持续进行；后者仅在位供应商获得新用户分配时才进行这些支付。当现有客户群用户处于边际内且议价无摩擦时，合同关联不影响供应商选择或竞争对手的均衡支付：分销商损失的支付恰好由在位供应商避免的支付所抵消。当存在合同摩擦时，平台范围协议可能排除更高效的竞争对手。
title: Platform-Wide Agreements and Competition for New Users
title_zh: 平台范围协议与新用户竞争

abstract: This paper studies whether local governments use land sales to buffer trade shocks. Combining land transactions for 275 Chinese cities over 2015–2023 with a Bartik measure of US tariff exposure, we find that more exposed cities raise land-sale revenue after the US-China trade war through higher average prices rather than greater aggregate land area. The price increase reflects two channels: a shift toward high-grade land driven primarily by area expansion, and a within-use price increase in commercial-residential land with no corresponding area response. Mechanism analysis shows that tariff shocks weaken local economic activity and intensify fiscal pressure.
abstract_zh: 本文研究地方政府是否利用土地出让来缓冲贸易冲击。结合2015至2023年间中国275个城市的土地交易数据与美国关税暴露的Bartik度量，我们发现，在中美贸易战后，暴露程度更高的城市通过提高平均地价而非扩大土地出让总面积来增加土地出让收入。地价上涨反映了两条渠道：一是主要由面积扩张驱动的高等级土地占比提升，二是商业住宅用地内部价格上升而面积并无相应响应。机制分析表明，关税冲击削弱了地方经济活动并加剧了财政压力。

title: Tariff shocks and land sales: Evidence from China’s cities
title_zh: 关税冲击与土地出让：来自中国城市的证据

abstract: In the efforts being made by governments to reduce pesticide use, subsidies are an important instrument to encourage farmers to adopt more sustainable practices. Yet, their effectiveness remains uncertain due to diverse designs and contexts. To date, there are no studies that provide systematic synthesized evidence on the potentially heterogeneous effects of subsidies on pesticide use. The present study addresses this gap by conducting a meta‐analysis of 39 empirical studies (208 models) from the EU and other developed countries that examine the effects of subsidies on (i) direct measurement of pesticide use and (ii) indirect measurement of pesticide use based on the adoption of pesticide‐reducing practices. Using probit meta‐regressions and qualitative appraisal, we find two key results. First, for EU studies, Pillar I and Pillar II subsidies from the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) have opposite effects on pesticide use: Pillar II subsidies are more likely than Pillar I subsidies to reduce pesticide use. Second, if we consider studies from both the EU and the US, subsidies that target adoption of whole‐farm systems or bundles of practices outperform those targeting a single practice in reducing pesticide use. We provide some policy recommendations for policy design and highlight future research priorities.
abstract_zh: 在各国政府减少农药使用的努力中，补贴是鼓励农民采纳更可持续做法的重要工具。然而，由于设计多样和情境差异，其有效性仍不确定。迄今为止，尚无研究提供关于补贴对农药使用可能存在的异质性效应的系统性综合证据。本研究通过荟萃分析39项来自欧盟及其他发达国家的实证研究（共208个模型），填补了这一空白，这些研究考察了补贴对（i）农药使用的直接测量及（ii）基于采纳减农药实践间接测量农药使用的影响。运用概率元回归及定性评估，我们得出两个关键结果。第一，就欧盟研究而言，共同农业政策（CAP）下的第一支柱和第二支柱补贴对农药使用具有相反效应：第二支柱补贴比第一支柱补贴更有可能减少农药使用。第二，若考虑欧盟和美国的研究，针对采纳整个农场系统或实践组合的补贴在减少农药使用方面优于针对单一实践的补贴。我们为政策设计提供了一些建议，并强调了未来研究的优先方向。
title: Assessing Government Subsidies for Reducing Pesticide Use: A Meta‐Analysis
title_zh: 评估政府补贴减少农药使用的效果：一项元分析

abstract: The Livestock Mandatory Reporting Act of 1999 was enacted to facilitate price reporting and increase market transparency. With immense structural change in the cattle industry, current practices of reporting weighted average prices are becoming less meaningful. Recent studies indicate that with the collection of additional data beyond what is currently available under the act, hedonic modeling may hold potential to facilitate more meaningful price reporting. This study revisits the issue using transaction level prices from four beef packers and finds incorporating the recommended information improves hedonic models' representation of prices. Though improved model specification enhances coefficient consistency, with particularly promising results for quality grades, remaining variation in sign and significance of other daily estimated coefficients undermines the approach's ability to inform intuitive premiums and discounts for some characteristics. Future research may explore on balance the relative merit of further improvement in data collection, model specification, and increasing observations with longer multiday rolling regressions to facilitate price reporting.
abstract_zh: 1999年《牲畜强制报告法案》旨在促进价格报告并提高市场透明度。随着养牛业经历巨大结构性变革，当前报告加权平均价格的做法正逐渐失去意义。近期研究表明，若在该法案现有基础上收集更多数据，特征价格模型可能有助于实现更具意义的价格报告。本研究利用四家牛肉加工企业的交易层面价格数据重新审视此问题，发现纳入推荐信息可改善特征价格模型对价格的呈现。尽管改进的模型设定增强了系数一致性，尤其在质量等级方面结果颇具前景，但其他日常估计系数的符号和显著性仍存在波动，这削弱了该方法为某些特征提供直观溢价和折价信息的能力。未来研究可权衡进一步改进数据收集、模型设定以及通过延长多日滚动回归增加观测值的相对价值，以促进价格报告。
title: Hedonic Modeling for Fed Cattle Price Reporting and Market Transparency
title_zh: 联邦牛价格报告的享乐模型与市场透明度

abstract: Evolutionary economics explains economic change through variation, selection, retention, transmission, innovation, and institutional transformation, whereas much of economics explains outcomes through purposive choice. This article argues that these modes of explanation become recursively connected once economic agents can represent the evolutionary processes in which they participate and intentionally alter their operation. It develops the concept of reflexive economic evolution: agents do not merely choose within given constraints or adapt to existing selection pressures, but can generate new possibilities, modify selection environments, organize transmission, and sometimes revise the criteria and mechanisms by which variants are selected. This latter second-order capacity is termed meta-selection. Reflexive economic evolution does not imply comprehensive control or a predetermined social end-state: guidance changes the distribution of possible trajectories under uncertainty rather than determining a trajectory. The framework shows how intentional and evolutionary explanations can be causally complementary, why effective agency is partly endogenous, and why policy should be understood not only as changing current outcomes but also as reshaping the evolutionary environment in which subsequent adaptation and innovation occur.
abstract_zh: 演化经济学通过变异、选择、保留、传递、创新及制度转型来解释经济变迁，而多数经济学则通过有目的的选择来解释结果。本文认为，一旦经济行为者能够表征其所参与的演化过程并有意识地改变其运作方式，这两种解释模式便会递归地相互关联。本文提出了反思性经济演化的概念：行为者不仅是在既定约束内进行选择或适应现有的选择压力，还能创造新的可能性、修改选择环境、组织传递，有时甚至修订变异被选择的标准与机制。这后一种二阶能力被称为元选择。反思性经济演化并不意味着全面控制或预设社会终极状态：引导改变的是不确定性下可能轨迹的分布，而非决定某条特定轨迹。该框架展示了意向性解释与演化解释如何在因果上互补，为何有效能动性部分内生于过程，以及为何政策应被理解为不仅改变当前结果，还重塑后续适应与创新所发生的演化环境。
title: Beyond Optimization and Blind Selection: Reflexive Agency in Economic Evolution
title_zh: 超越优化与盲目选择：经济演化中的反思性能动性

abstract: How reliable are public debt statistics? This paper quantifies the magnitude, characteristics, and timing of hidden debt by tracking ex post revisions to sovereign debt statistics. We assemble a comprehensive new database of 119 editions, or vintages, of League of Nations, United Nations, IMF, and World Bank debt statistics, covering up to 187 countries over more than a century. We show that public debt is systematically underreported, with upward revisions averaging roughly one percent of GDP across advanced and developing economies, external and domestic debt, and all reporting systems we examine. Hidden debt accumulates in good times and tends to be revealed in bad times, often during IMF programs and sovereign defaults. Over the past one hundred years, nearly half of all sovereign defaults have coincided with substantial upward revisions to reported public debt. We incorporate these patterns into a quantitative sovereign default model and show that hidden debt raises default risk and borrowing costs, and thereby contributes to debt intolerance. Differences in the reliability of debt data across countries account for roughly 20% of the observed gap in debt-carrying capacity between low and high-income economies.
abstract_zh: 公共债务统计的可靠性如何？本文通过追踪主权债务统计的事后修正，量化了隐性债务的规模、特征及其出现时机。我们汇编了一个全面的新数据库，涵盖国际联盟、联合国、国际货币基金组织和世界银行债务统计的119个版本（即“代际”），覆盖多达187个国家，时间跨度超过一个世纪。研究表明，公共债务被系统性低估，向上修正平均约为GDP的1%，这一现象在发达经济体与发展中经济体、外部债务与国内债务以及我们所考察的所有报告体系中均普遍存在。隐性债务在经济繁荣时期累积，往往在经济衰退时期暴露，尤其是在国际货币基金组织项目期间及主权违约发生时。过去一百年中，近一半的主权违约事件伴随着报告公共债务的大幅向上修正。我们将这些模式纳入一个量化的主权违约模型，并显示隐性债务提高了违约风险和借贷成本，从而加剧了“债务不耐受”现象。各国债务数据可靠性的差异，解释了低收入与高收入经济体之间债务承载能力差距的约20%。
title: Hidden Debt Revelations
title_zh: 隐性债务揭示

abstract: Agrodealers play a critical role in rural economies, selling essential inputs for agricultural production, stocking new products, and providing farmers with technical advice. However, uncertainty can discourage them from stocking newer, less familiar products, limiting the availability of innovative technologies and leading to market failures and low‐innovation equilibria. We provided Kenyan agrodealers with a 10% price discount on new, drought‐tolerant maize hybrids. The discount increased the likelihood that the agrodealer stocked the new hybrids and increased the share of the new hybrids in overall sales. In an information‐deprived environment, the discount encouraged dealers to gather more information about the seeds and increased agrodealers' sales effort.
abstract_zh: 农业经销商在农村经济中扮演着关键角色，他们销售农业生产所需的基本投入品，储备新产品，并向农民提供技术咨询。然而，不确定性可能阻碍他们储备更新、更不熟悉的产品，从而限制创新技术的可获得性，导致市场失灵和低创新均衡。我们向肯尼亚农业经销商提供了10%的价格折扣，用于购买新的耐旱玉米杂交种。这一折扣提高了经销商储备新杂交种的可能性，并增加了新杂交种在总销售额中的占比。在信息匮乏的环境中，折扣促使经销商收集更多关于种子的信息，并增强了经销商的销售努力。
title: Improving access to new technologies: An experiment with Kenyan input sellers
title_zh: 改善新技术获取渠道：针对肯尼亚农资经销商的实验研究

abstract: Using a state‐of‐the‐art structural gravity model, we investigate the impact of various (post‐)colonial cocoa trading arrangements on the cocoa trade between developing cocoa producer countries and rich industrial cocoa consumer nations in the time period 1951–1999. We find that in particular the trading arrangements of the European (Economic) Community (EEC/EC), such as the Association, Yaoundé and Lomé Agreements, as well as the UNCTAD International Cocoa Agreement, had a measurable positive impact on cocoa trade flows, in contrast to the British Commonwealth partnership or the GATT Generalised System of Preferences. In particular, the Yaoundé Agreement not only increased the trade between other EEC/EC members and the signatory cocoa producers, but also strengthened the trading relationship between the former coloniser countries and their cocoa producing former colonies, in fact more than offsetting the negative effect of independence.
abstract_zh: 利用最先进的结构引力模型，我们研究了1951年至1999年间各种（后）殖民时期可可贸易安排对发展中国家可可生产国与富裕工业可可消费国之间可可贸易的影响。我们发现，尤其是欧洲（经济）共同体（EEC/EC）的贸易安排，如联系协定、雅温得协定和洛美协定，以及联合国贸发会议的国际可可协定，对可可贸易流产生了显著的正面影响，这与英联邦伙伴关系或关贸总协定普遍优惠制形成对比。特别是雅温得协定，不仅促进了其他EEC/EC成员国与签署国可可生产国之间的贸易，还加强了前殖民国家与其可可生产前殖民地之间的贸易关系，实际上其正面效应超过了独立带来的负面影响。
title: International Cocoa Trading Arrangements Between Industrialised and Developing Countries 1951–1999: A Structural Gravity Analysis
title_zh: 工业化国家与发展中国家之间的国际可可贸易安排（1951—1999年）：结构引力分析

abstract: Mandatory minimum (MM) sentencing is frequently identified as a driver of long sentences among federal drug offenders, but estimating its causal impact is complicated by prosecutorial discretion in charging. First, I show evidence of selective manipulation of MM eligibility, with prosecutors disproportionately choosing minority defendants for eligibility relative to comparable white defendants. This selection behavior creates bias in naive estimates of MM effects on sentence length. To recover the causal impact of MM eligibility, I use a regression discontinuity design with extrapolation that disentangles statutory effects from prosecutorial selection. I find that eligibility increases sentence length by approximately 10 months (14 percent) uniformly across case types, with no discernible heterogeneity across race. Together, these results indicate that racial disparities in MM sentencing arise primarily from prosecutorial charging decisions rather than from features of the statute itself.
abstract_zh: 强制性最低刑期（MM）量刑常被视为联邦毒品犯罪者长期监禁的一个驱动因素，但评估其因果影响因检察官在指控中的自由裁量权而变得复杂。首先，我展示了MM资格选择性操纵的证据，检察官相对于类似的白人被告，不成比例地选择少数族裔被告符合资格。这种选择行为在朴素估计MM对刑期长度的影响时造成了偏差。为恢复MM资格的因果效应，我采用带有外推的回归断点设计，以区分法定效应与检察官选择效应。我发现，资格使刑期平均增加约10个月（14%），且在不同案件类型中一致，种族间未观察到明显异质性。综合来看，这些结果表明，MM量刑中的种族差异主要源于检察官的指控决定，而非法规本身的特点。
title: How much do mandatory minimums matter?
title_zh: 强制性最低刑罚有多重要？

abstract: Stock price delay serves as a key metric of information efficiency in stock markets, and identifying its determinants is essential for promoting market information efficiency. This study examines the effect of open public data (OPD) on stock price delay. Using the staggered adoption of city-level OPD portals in China as a quasi-natural experiment, our difference-in-differences analysis finds that OPD significantly reduces stock price delay, with an economic magnitude representing approximately 7.9% of its standard deviation. Cross-sectional analyses demonstrate that this effect is more pronounced when (1) public data on OPD portals are of higher quality, (2) public data are more relevant to firm operations, (3) public data are less substitutable, (4) investors have greater information processing capacity, and (5) firms’ information disclosure quality is lower. Additional tests show that OPD implementation is associated with improved liquidity, reduced return volatility, and diminished information content of earnings announcements. This study makes a valuable contribution to the literature on the determinants of stock price delay and the economic consequences of OPD, while offering insights for policymakers seeking to enhance market information efficiency and assess the effectiveness of OPD initiatives. 1 Under the Chinese institutional setting, a firm’s registered city generally coincides with the location of its headquarters rather than merely serving as a legal place of incorporation. According to the Company Law of the People’s Republic of China and the Regulations on the Administration of Market Entities Registration , a company’s registered domicile must correspond to the location of its principal administrative office, and firms relocating their principal office are required to update their registration accordingly (Chen, Hung, and Wang Citation 2018). Consequently, firms’ registered cities generally represent the locations of their headquarters. Because local governments in China play an active role in firms’ operations and are responsible for taxation, administrative approvals, industrial policy implementation, regulatory oversight, and other aspects of the local business environment (Xu Citation 2011), firms’ registered cities also represent the local institutional and information environments surrounding their headquarters. 3 GF Securities has developed an enterprise financial intelligent early-warning platform based on large-scale pre-trained models, which leverages public data and artificial intelligence to identify corporate financial risks at earlier stages and with greater accuracy. Similarly, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange’s blockchain-based industry risk data sharing project enhances the secure sharing of risk information across market participants, enabling investors to better assess industry-level risks. abstract_zh: 股票价格延迟是衡量股票市场信息效率的关键指标，识别其决定因素对于促进市场信息效率至关重要。本研究考察了开放公共数据（OPD）对股票价格延迟的影响。利用中国城市级OPD门户网站的分阶段采纳作为准自然实验，我们的双重差分分析发现，OPD显著降低了股票价格延迟，其经济幅度约占其标准差7.9%。横截面分析表明，当（1）OPD门户网站上的公共数据质量更高，（2）公共数据与企业运营更相关，（3）公共数据的可替代性较低，（4）投资者的信息处理能力更强，以及（5）企业的信息披露质量较低时，这一效应更为显著。附加测试显示，OPD的实施与流动性改善、回报波动性降低以及盈余公告信息含量减少相关联。本研究为股票价格延迟决定因素及OPD经济后果的文献做出了有价值的贡献，同时为旨在提升市场信息效率和评估OPD举措有效性的政策制定者提供了见解。¹ 在中国制度背景下，企业的注册城市通常与其总部所在地一致，而非仅仅作为法定注册地。根据《中华人民共和国公司法》和《市场主体登记管理条例》，公司的注册住所必须与其主要办事机构所在地相符，企业迁移主要办事机构时需相应更新注册信息（Chen, Hung, and Wang Citation 2018）。因此，企业的注册城市通常代表其总部所在地。由于中国地方政府在企业运营中发挥积极作用，并负责税收、行政审批、产业政策实施、监管监督以及地方商业环境其他方面的事务（Xu Citation 2011），企业的注册城市也代表了其总部周边的本地制度和信息环境。³ 广发证券基于大规模预训练模型开发了企业财务智能预警平台，该平台利用公共数据和人工智能，以更早阶段和更高准确性识别企业财务风险。类似地，深圳证券交易所基于区块链的行业风险数据共享项目增强了市场参与者之间风险信息的安全共享，使投资者能够更好地评估行业层面风险。上海股权交易所推出了基于区块链的股权登记、托管和转让服务平台，该平台整合多源数据，为股权市场投资者提供更客观的估值基准。更多详情，请参见 https://www.csrc.gov.cn/shanxi/c106408/c7568249/content.shtml、https://jrj.sh.gov.cn/SC212/20241023/7f10aa43b0424212b06e0385adaece26.html 和 https://finance.stockstar.com/IG2024102200029365.shtml。⁴ 在本研究中，由于样本仅限于中国A股市场，企业-日观测值等同于证券-日观测值。方程Eq. abstract: This study contributes to the literature on inequality of educational opportunity (IEOp) by advancing both the measurement and the empirical analysis of how social background shapes educational attainment in the United States over time. The study makes several key contributions. First, whereas existing studies typically rely on a limited set of circumstance variables, this study incorporates a more comprehensive and multidimensional set of background characteristics. Second, the paper introduces a novel composite measure – the Social Advantage Factor (SAF) – which summarizes multiple dimensions of social and economic background into a single index and overcomes the existing trade-off between capturing heterogeneity and maintaining statistical precision. Third, motivated by recent developments, this study employs machine-learning techniques to reduce reliance on ad hoc model selection, flexibly capture nonlinearities and interactions among circumstance variables, address multicollinearity, and enhance the robustness of opportunity estimates. In addition, this study provides a long-term perspective on inequality of educational opportunity by examining trends since 1920 across four distinct educational stages. The findings show that, over time, inequality of educational opportunity has decreased for ‘high school’ and ‘some college attainment’ levels. Evidence of persistent inequality remains at the college graduation level, while estimates for post-college attainment should be interpreted more cautiously due to weak model performance at this educational stage. KEYWORDS: Inequality educational opportunity Social Advantage Factor machine-learning JEL CLASSIFICATION: I24 I20 J18
abstract_zh: 本研究在推进教育机会不平等（IEOp）相关文献方面做出了贡献，既改进了测量方法，也深化了对美国社会背景如何随时间影响教育成就的实证分析。本研究具有多项关键贡献。首先，现有研究通常依赖有限的环境变量集，而本研究纳入了更为全面且多维的背景特征。其次，本文引入了一种新颖的复合测量指标——社会优势因子（SAF）——将社会与经济背景的多个维度汇总为单一指数，从而克服了在捕捉异质性与维持统计精度之间的现有权衡。第三，受近期研究进展启发，本研究采用机器学习技术，以减少对临时模型选择的依赖，灵活捕捉环境变量间的非线性关系与交互效应，处理多重共线性问题，并增强机会估计的稳健性。此外，本研究通过考察自1920年以来四个不同教育阶段的趋势，提供了教育机会不平等的长期视角。研究结果显示，随着时间的推移，“高中”和“部分大学教育”阶段的教育机会不平等有所下降。大学本科毕业阶段仍存在持续不平等的证据，而研究生及以上教育阶段的估计结果应更为谨慎地解读，因为该教育阶段的模型表现较弱。关键词：教育机会不平等 社会优势因子 机器学习 JEL分类：I24 I20 J18
title: The evolution of inequality of educational opportunity in USA: a machine-learning approach
title_zh: 美国教育机会不平等演变：一种机器学习方法

abstract: Consider the problem of designing a revenue-optimal auction mechanism when two heterogeneous items are sold to a single buyer having independent valuations over the items. The distributions of the buyer's valuation for the items are assumed to have densities that are positive, nondecreasing, and continuously differentiable on their support sets $[c_i,c_i+b_i]$ in the positive axis. I prove that the optimal mechanism is deterministic if at least one of the minimum valuations (i.e., either $c_1$ or $c_2$) is sufficiently high. I provide a method to calculate the threshold of $(c_1,c_2)$ beyond which the optimal mechanism is deterministic. I also provide a sufficient condition on the distributions of buyer's valuations for which the individual sale mechanism is optimal. I show that when $c_1$ is low and $c_2$ is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item $2$ at the minimum valuation $c_2$, thus effectively reducing the problem to finding the optimal mechanism in the one-dimensional setting only for item $1$. I conjecture with promising preliminary results that this result can be extended to the three-item setting. Specifically, I conjecture that when $c_1$ and $c_2$ are low but $c_3$ is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item $3$ at the minimum valuation $c_3$, thus effectively reducing the problem to finding the optimal mechanism in the two-dimensional setting for items $1$ and $2$.
abstract_zh: 考虑在将两种异质商品出售给对商品具有独立估值的单一买家时，设计收益最优拍卖机制的问题。假设买家对商品的估值分布具有正密度、非递减且在支撑集[ci, ci + bi]（位于正半轴）上连续可微。我证明，如果至少一个最低估值（即c1或c2）足够高，则最优机制是确定性的。我提供了一种方法来计算(c1, c2)的阈值，超过该阈值后最优机制即为确定性的。我还给出了买家估值分布的一个充分条件，在该条件下，单独销售机制是最优的。我表明，当c1较低而c2较高时，卖家以最低估值c2出售商品2是最优的，从而有效地将问题简化为仅针对商品1的一维设置中的最优机制求解。我推测，基于有前景的初步结果，这一结论可以扩展到三商品设置。具体而言，我推测当c1和c2较低但c3较高时，卖家以最低估值c3出售商品3是最优的，从而有效地将问题简化为针对商品1和2的二维设置中的最优机制求解。
title: On deterministic optimal mechanisms in a two-item setting for distributions with nondecreasing density
title_zh: 确定性最优机制：两物品情形下非递减密度分布的研究

abstract: We explore the use of Revelio data—obtained primarily from LinkedIn profiles—as a source of labor force microdata in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where large-sample, high-frequency, employer-linked alternatives are largely unavailable. To address the selection inherent to LinkedIn usership, we employ ILO labor statistics to construct five sets of country-year-specific weights that alleviate non-representativeness across occupation, industry, occupation × education, industry × education, and industry × firm-size cells. We further validate these weights using national census data where they are available and not used for ILO labor statistics. The weighted dataset provides a balanced monthly panel with coverage across most LMICs. We also discuss remaining limitations of the dataset, including within-cell selection and self-reporting errors, and suggest techniques to alleviate them. Despite imperfect coverage, Revelio offers improved temporal and geographical resolution as well as cross-country comparability and is especially useful for studying the role of firms in economic development.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了利用Revelio数据——主要源自LinkedIn个人资料——作为低收入和中等收入国家劳动力微观数据来源的可能性，在这些国家，大规模、高频、与雇主关联的替代数据基本不可得。为应对LinkedIn用户群体固有的选择性偏差，我们采用国际劳工组织的劳动统计资料，构建了五组按国家-年份特定的权重，以缓解在职业、行业、职业×教育、行业×教育及行业×企业规模等分类上的非代表性。我们还利用可获取且未用于国际劳工组织统计的国家人口普查数据，对这些权重进行了进一步验证。加权后的数据集提供了一个覆盖大多数低收入和中等收入国家的平衡月度面板。我们还讨论了数据集现存的其他局限，包括单元内选择及自我报告误差，并提出了缓解这些问题的技术方法。尽管覆盖并非完美，Revelio数据在时间与地理分辨率上有所提升，并增强了跨国可比性，尤其适用于研究企业在经济发展中的作用。
title: From LinkedIn to Labor Statistics: Using Revelio Microdata for Labor Market Research in Developing Economies
title_zh: 从领英到劳动统计：利用Revelio微观数据研究发展中经济体的劳动力市场

abstract: We examine whether disproportionate insider control, or the divergence between insider voting and cash flow rights at dual-class firms, influences the extent to which stock price reflects information about future firm performance. We find that current returns incorporate less information about future earnings and cash flows as disproportionate insider control increases. However, monitoring by influential institutional investors, strong board oversight, and high-quality disclosure significantly attenuate this effect, such that disproportionate insider control does not result in less informative stock prices. Collectively, our findings reveal that, although the dual-class structure is associated with less informative stock prices, on average, monitoring and disclosure can alleviate investor concerns about disproportionate insider control while allowing firms to take advantage of the benefits of a dual-class ownership structure.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了双重股权结构公司中不成比例的内部人控制，即内部人投票权与现金流权之间的差异，是否影响股价反映未来公司业绩信息的程度。研究发现，随着不成比例的内部人控制增强，当前收益对未来盈利和现金流信息的包含程度降低。然而，有影响力的机构投资者监督、强有力的董事会监管以及高质量的信息披露显著削弱了这一效应，使得不成比例的内部人控制不会导致股价信息含量降低。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，尽管双重股权结构平均而言与股价信息含量较低相关，但监督和披露能够缓解投资者对不成比例内部人控制的担忧，同时使企业能够利用双重股权结构带来的优势。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The informativeness of stock price at dual-class firms
title_zh: 双重股权结构公司股票价格的信息含量

abstract: Climate change and the transition to net zero are reshaping the macroeconomy, with important implications for monetary policymakers’ core price-stability objectives. As physical hazards become more frequent and severe, and as governments’ mitigation policies reallocate resources across the economy, central banks may increasingly face challenging trade-offs between stabilising inflation and supporting output. This column discusses the implications of climate change for monetary policy, including its effects on inflation, output, monetary transmission, structural economic factors and central bank communications. It introduces a practical framework for central banks as they assess, respond to, and communicate about climate-related shocks.
abstract_zh: 气候变化及向净零排放的转型正在重塑宏观经济，对货币政策制定者的核心价格稳定目标产生重要影响。随着物理危害日益频繁和严重，以及政府减缓政策在经济中重新分配资源，中央银行可能越来越面临在稳定通胀与支持产出之间的艰难权衡。本文探讨了气候变化对货币政策的影响，包括其对通胀、产出、货币传导机制、结构性经济因素及中央银行沟通的作用。文章为中央银行评估、应对及沟通气候相关冲击提供了一个实用框架。
authors: Solveig K. Erlandsen, Sui-Jade Ho, Danae Kyriakopoulou, James Talbot, Edwin Millar
title: The implications of climate change for monetary policy
title_zh: 气候变化对货币政策的影响

abstract: Standard portfolio theory predicts strong investor responses to changes in the equity premium, but empirical evidence has found much lower sensitivity. This column studies the effects of changes in the Norwegian wealth tax, which generated variation in the after-tax equity premium. It finds that investors adjusted strongly, but slowly, with adjustment continuing for several years. This is consistent with the presence of adjustment frictions, such as attention or information costs. The findings can also help reconcile household portfolio behaviour with standard levels of risk aversion.
abstract_zh: 标准投资组合理论预测投资者会对股权溢价变化作出强烈反应，但实证证据显示其敏感度远低于此。本文研究了挪威财富税变动的影响，该变动导致了税后股权溢价的差异。研究发现，投资者调整幅度显著但过程缓慢，调整持续数年之久。这与调整摩擦的存在相符，如注意力或信息成本。这些发现也有助于调和家庭投资组合行为与标准风险厌恶水平之间的关系。
authors: Andreas Fagereng, Luigi Guiso, Marius Ring
title: New evidence of strong but slow portfolio responses to equity premium changes
title_zh: 股票溢价变化下投资组合反应强烈但缓慢的新证据

abstract: This paper develops an empirical model to predict episodes of debt servicing difficulties (“debt distress”) in low-income countries, with three main contributions to the existing literature. First, it develops more refined measures of external debt distress episodes that allow timing the onset of distress episodes with increased precision. Second, it develops a systematic algorithm to comprehensively assess the out-of-sample predictive performance of more than 550,000 candidate binary prediction models using J-K-fold cross-validation. Third, it tests whether more sophisticated machine learning algorithms can outperform simple probit models. The paper finds that simple single-equation probit models have better predictive power for debt distress than more sophisticated algorithms and are comparable in terms of predictive performance to important policy benchmarks such as the IMF and World Bank debt sustainability framework for low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个实证模型，用以预测低收入国家债务偿付困难（“债务困境”）的阶段，对现有文献有三项主要贡献。第一，它开发了更为精细的外债困境阶段度量方法，使得能够更精确地确定困境阶段的起始时间。第二，它设计了一套系统性算法，通过J-K折交叉验证，全面评估超过55万个候选二元预测模型的样本外预测性能。第三，它检验了更为复杂的机器学习算法是否能超越简单的概率单位模型。研究发现，简单的单方程概率单位模型在预测债务困境方面优于更复杂的算法，并且在预测性能上与诸如国际货币基金组织和世界银行针对低收入国家的债务可持续性框架等重要政策基准相当。

abstract: Solar and wind power account for a growing share of electricity generation in China and now dominate new capacity additions. As the power system transitions toward renewable generation, greater flexibility will be required to maintain system stability. This paper uses a computable general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic implications of this transition. Model results indicate a modest increase in electricity prices in the near-term, followed by sustained declines as renewable shares rise, particularly when variability is managed through battery storage rather than coal-fired backup generation. While the transition requires substantial adjustments in electricity supply and investment, it raises GDP in the long run and strengthens energy security. Battery-based flexibility outperforms continued reliance on coal across multiple dimensions, even when accounting for rising electricity demand from emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence. However, this transition pathway also increases the risk of stranded assets in the coal power sector.
abstract_zh: 太阳能和风能在中国电力生产中所占份额日益增长，目前已成为新增装机容量的主导力量。随着电力系统向可再生能源转型，维持系统稳定性将需要更大的灵活性。本文运用可计算一般均衡模型评估这一转型的宏观经济影响。模型结果显示，短期内电价将温和上涨，随后随着可再生能源占比上升而持续下降，尤其是在通过电池储能而非燃煤备用发电来管理波动性的情况下。尽管这一转型要求电力供应和投资进行大幅调整，但从长远来看，它将提升国内生产总值并增强能源安全。即使在考虑人工智能等新兴技术带来的电力需求增长时，基于电池的灵活性方案在多个维度上仍优于继续依赖煤炭。然而，这一转型路径也增加了煤电行业资产搁浅的风险。
