abstract: This paper analyzes the credit-growth nexus by shifting the focus from aggregate leverage and credit stocks to new credit flows. Using quarterly data for 12 euro area countries over 2007–24, covering 96 percent of euro area GDP, the analysis shows a robust empirical association between newly granted bank credit and private final domestic demand (PFDD), a close proxy for GDP. A 10 percent increase in new private credit is associated with about 0.5–0.7 percentage points growth in PFDD. In contrast, specifications based on credit stocks or leverage produce unstable or counterintuitive estimates, reflecting measurement biases related to debt repayments and denominator effects. Nothwithstanding the importance of debt levels and leverage for financial stability and through debt service for the economy, the findings suggest that new credit flows appear to provide a more empirically reliable proxy for the macroeconomic role of bank lending.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将研究焦点从总体杠杆率和信贷存量转向新增信贷流量，分析了信贷与增长之间的关系。利用2007年至2024年间12个欧元区国家的季度数据，覆盖欧元区GDP的96%，分析显示新增银行信贷与私人最终国内需求（PFDD）之间存在稳健的经验关联，后者是GDP的紧密近似指标。新增私人信贷每增加10%，与PFDD增长约0.5至0.7个百分点相关。相比之下，基于信贷存量或杠杆率的规格估计结果不稳定或违背直觉，这反映了与债务偿还和分母效应相关的测量偏差。尽管债务水平和杠杆率对金融稳定以及通过债务服务对经济具有重要意义，但研究结果表明，新增信贷流量似乎为银行信贷的宏观经济作用提供了更具经验可靠性的代理指标。
title: Rethinking the Credit-Growth Nexus: New Credit Flows and Private Demand in the Euro Area
title_zh: 重新审视信贷与增长的关系：欧元区新增信贷流动与私人需求

abstract: Whether exporters can take advantage of increases in foreign demand depends on the scalability of their input suppliers—that is, suppliers’ ability to expand production when demand rises. Using bilateral trade data linked to international input-output tables, I measure supplier scalability at the country-industry level and examine how it shapes downstream export growth. I find that supplier scalability varies sharply across industries within countries, that scalable suppliers tend to be connected to scalable suppliers themselves, and that downstream country-sectors exposed to more scalable suppliers respond more strongly to positive foreign demand shocks in sectors with relationship-sticky inputs. I rationalize these facts in a multicountry, multi-sector general-equilibrium trade model with input-output linkages, heterogeneous upward-sloping supplier supply curves, and gradually adjusting sourcing relationships. In the calibrated model, supplier bottlenecks substantially attenuate the export and welfare gains from a global demand expansion, while relationship stickiness determines where bottlenecks bind. Counterfactuals show that supplier upgrading and pre-arranged access to flexible sourcing networks are most valuable when targeted toward economically central, relationship-sticky, and bottleneck-exposed parts of the production network.
abstract_zh: 出口商能否利用外国需求的增长，取决于其投入品供应商的可扩展性——即供应商在需求上升时扩大生产的能力。通过将双边贸易数据与国际投入产出表相结合，我在国家-行业层面衡量了供应商的可扩展性，并考察其如何影响下游出口增长。研究发现，供应商可扩展性在国家内部各行业间差异显著，可扩展的供应商往往与其他可扩展供应商相互关联，且下游国家-部门若接触更多可扩展供应商，则在涉及关系粘性投入品的行业中，对正向外国需求冲击的反应更为强烈。我将这些事实纳入一个包含投入产出联系、异质性向上倾斜的供应商供给曲线以及逐步调整的采购关系的多国、多部门一般均衡贸易模型中加以解释。在校准模型中，供应商瓶颈显著削弱了全球需求扩张带来的出口与福利收益，而关系粘性则决定了瓶颈在何处产生约束。反事实分析表明，当供应商升级及预先安排灵活采购网络的可及性被定向于生产网络中经济核心、关系粘性且面临瓶颈暴露的部分时，其价值最为显著。

title: Scalable Suppliers in Global Trade Networks
title_zh: 全球贸易网络中的可扩展供应商

abstract: We augment the two-country DSGE model from Mandelman and Zlate (2012) with endogenous migration of both skilled and unskilled labor, and analyze the economic impact of restricting migration for each type of labor on the migrants’ source and host countries. We calibrate the model with data for Guatemala and the U.S. as the source and host countries respectively. Restricting unskilled immigration has a more severe contractionary impact on the host economy than restricting skilled migration—reducing aggregate output by approximately 1 percent and consumption by 0.6 percent compared to the steady state—, given that in the steady state a lot more unskilled migrants are needed in the production function. Restricting unskilled immigration impacts negatively skilled immigration flows, but not vice versa, and it has a significant overall impact on the source economy, with aggregate consumption and income declining (mostly due to a fall in remittances). Our findings also highlight a key policy trade-off for the host economy: while a restrictive immigration policy (especially for unskilled labor) could reduce wage inequality by compressing the skill premium—raising host-country unskilled wages by 8 percent while lowering skilled wages by 1 percent compared to the steady state—, and could increase output per capita, it comes at the cost of lower overall economic activity and aggregate consumption. Moreover, by increasing the wage gap for unskilled labor between host and source economies, it also raises incentives for immigration, despite the increased cost of migration.
abstract_zh: 我们在Mandelman和Zlate（2012）的双国DSGE模型中加入了技能与非技能劳动力的内生迁移，并分析了限制各类劳动力迁移对移民来源国和东道国经济的影响。我们利用危地马拉和美国分别作为来源国和东道国的数据对模型进行了校准。限制非技能移民对东道国经济的紧缩效应比限制技能迁移更为严重——与稳态相比，总产出减少约1%，消费减少0.6%——这是因为在稳态下，生产函数中需要更多的非技能移民。限制非技能移民对技能移民流动产生负面影响，但反之则不然，并且对来源国经济具有显著的整体影响，总消费和收入下降（主要归因于汇款减少）。我们的研究结果还凸显了东道国面临的一个关键政策权衡：虽然限制性移民政策（尤其是针对非技能劳动力）可能通过压缩技能溢价来降低工资不平等——与稳态相比，东道国非技能工资上升8%，而技能工资下降1%——并可能提高人均产出，但这是以降低整体经济活动和总消费为代价的。此外，通过扩大东道国与来源国之间非技能劳动力的工资差距，该政策也增加了移民的激励，尽管移民成本有所上升。
authors: Ms. Alina Carare & Metodij Hadzi-Vaskov & Jessie Kilembe & Felipe Leal
title: Assessing the Impact of Restricting Skilled and Unskilled Migration: A General Equilibrium Approach
title_zh: 评估限制技能与非技能移民的影响：一般均衡方法

abstract: This paper studies market power in Mexican industries over the period 2008-23 using establishment-level data from the Mexican Economic Census. We document a substantial increase in the average price markup over marginal costs, from 12 percent in 2008 to 27 percent in 2023. The sources of this increase vary across sectors and time: services, particularly wholesale and retail trade, account for most of the increase in markups until 2018, while manufacturing, led by transportation equipment and export-oriented industries, plays a larger role in more recent years. Rising markups in services are associated with greater local labor market concentration, suggestive of increasing monopsony power. In manufacturing, markup growth is linked to higher capital expenditure, consistent with firms sustaining larger markups to recover higher fixed costs. Moreover, rising markups in manufacturing are positively associated with total factor productivity, whereas in services they are uncorrelated with productivity. Overall, these findings suggest that while market power has increased over time, its underlying drivers have shifted from monopsonistic power in labor markets to higher fixed costs, with more favorable efficiency implications in recent years.
abstract_zh: 本文利用墨西哥经济普查的企业层面数据，研究了2008年至2023年间墨西哥行业的市场势力。我们记录了平均价格加成率相对于边际成本的显著上升，从2008年的12%增至2023年的27%。这一增长的来源在不同部门和时间段有所差异：服务业，尤其是批发和零售贸易，在2018年前贡献了加成率增长的大部分；而制造业，以运输设备和出口导向型行业为主导，在近年发挥了更大作用。服务业加成率的上升与地方劳动力市场集中度的提高相关，暗示着买方垄断势力的增强。在制造业中，加成率的增长与更高的资本支出相关联，这与企业维持较大加成率以回收更高固定成本的现象一致。此外，制造业中加成率的上升与全要素生产率呈正相关，而在服务业中则与生产率无相关性。总体而言，这些发现表明，尽管市场势力随时间增强，其潜在驱动因素已从劳动力市场的买方垄断势力转向更高的固定成本，且近年来的效率影响更为有利。
authors: Francisco Arizala & Diana Ricciulli-Marín & Johanna Schauer

abstract: As low-income countries (LICs) gain access to international capital markets, the scope for increased financing rises but so does the risk of shocks. Our empirical results suggest that, after the global financial crisis (GFC), the global financial cycle has been a significant driver of private capital flows to LICs. In particular, a stronger US dollar (against advanced economy currencies) was associated with weaker net inflows. We also find that external government borrowing in LICs had a statistically significant but relatively small counter-cyclical component, inversely related to global financial and economic cycles, complementing policy responses to shocks.
abstract_zh: 随着低收入国家（LICs）获得国际资本市场的准入，融资空间增大，但冲击风险也随之上升。我们的实证结果表明，在全球金融危机（GFC）之后，全球金融周期已成为低收入国家私人资本流动的重要驱动因素。特别是，美元（相对于发达经济体货币）走强与净流入减弱相关联。我们还发现，低收入国家的外部政府借款具有统计上显著但相对较小的逆周期成分，与全球金融和经济周期呈反向关系，补充了对冲击的政策应对措施。
title: Riding the Global Financial Cycle: How Capital Flows into LICs
title_zh: 驾驭全球金融周期：资本如何流入低收入国家

abstract: This paper investigates the drivers of labor productivity growth in the Nordic countries, using both sectoral and firm-level data over the period 2000–2024. The sectoral analysis documents a broad-based slowdown in labor productivity growth, driven primarily by within-industry developments rather than shifts in the sectoral composition of employment. Firm-level evidence shows that productivity growth is increasingly concentrated among frontier firms—the most productive firms within each industry—while the rest of the firm distribution (“laggards”) has experienced weak or stagnant productivity growth. A decomposition of frontier productivity growth reveals that gains among incumbent frontier firms account for most productivity growth at the frontier across countries. The contribution of net firm entry is highly heterogeneous, and is positive mainly in countries where young entering firms exhibit strong productivity momentum upon joining the frontier. The paper finds evidence of productivity diffusion from frontier to laggard firms but shows that the speed of diffusion has declined since the 2010s. The slower diffusion is closely associated with rising persistence at the productivity frontier: when the same firms remain at the frontier for longer periods, opportunities for laggards to catch up are reduced. Overall, the findings highlight that sustaining aggregate productivity growth hinges not only on innovation at the frontier but also on firm dynamism—particularly entry, exit, and turnover at the frontier—to ensure that productivity gains diffuse broadly across the economy.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2000年至2024年间北欧国家劳动生产率增长的驱动因素，利用部门与企业层面的数据进行分析。部门分析揭示了劳动生产率增长普遍放缓的现象，这一趋势主要由行业内发展动态所驱动，而非就业部门构成的变化所致。企业层面的证据表明，生产率增长日益集中于各行业内的前沿企业——即最具生产力的企业，而其余企业分布（“落后者”）则经历了疲弱或停滞的生产率增长。对前沿生产率增长的分解显示，现有前沿企业的收益贡献了各国前沿生产率增长的大部分。净企业进入的贡献高度异质，主要在对加入前沿的年轻进入企业展现出强劲生产率动力的国家中表现为正效应。本文发现了从前沿企业向落后企业扩散生产率的证据，但指出自2010年代以来扩散速度有所下降。较慢的扩散与生产率前沿持久性的上升密切相关：当同一批企业长期占据前沿位置时，落后者追赶的机会减少。总体而言，研究结果强调，维持总体生产率增长不仅依赖于前沿的创新，还依赖于企业活力——尤其是前沿的进入、退出和更替——以确保生产率收益在整个经济中广泛扩散。
title: Labor Productivity Growth in the Nordics: The Roles of Frontier Firms and Diffusion
title_zh: 北欧劳动生产率的增长：前沿企业与技术扩散的作用

abstract: Amid sharp house price increases in some parts of Europe, housing affordability has again become one of the main concern of households. This paper conducts three complementary sets of analyses to shed light on the drivers and economic implications of declining housing affordability. First, using a structural VAR, we show that supply-side factors have become increasingly prominent drivers of house prices—a notable shift from the credit-driven price increases that preceded the Global Financial Crisis. Second, drawing on household-level EU-SILC data, we argue that the burden has fallen disproportionately on lower-income urban renters, who face both rising rents and diminishing prospects of transitioning to homeownership. This is especially true for financially more vulnerable renters who have seen their probability of becoming home owners fall by more than half since the pre-GFC period. Third, we provide new empirical evidence that the resulting widening of income and wealth gaps between owners and renters is compounded by the efficiency cost of reduced labor mobility, as high housing costs make it harder for workers to move to more productive locations – quantitively, housing affordability constraints might have led to around one million foregone moves within the EU over the past decade. The analyses underpin the policy recommendations to alleviate housing affordability challenges set out in the IMF’s 2026 Euro Area consultation, including the need to focus on national measures to boost housing supply, with a complementary role for EU-level action.
abstract_zh: 在欧洲部分地区房价急剧上涨的背景下，住房可负担性再次成为家庭关注的核心问题之一。本文通过三组互补的分析，旨在揭示住房可负担性下降的驱动因素及其经济影响。首先，运用结构向量自回归模型，我们表明供给侧因素日益成为房价的主要驱动力——这一变化与全球金融危机前信贷驱动的房价上涨形成鲜明对比。其次，基于家庭层面的欧盟收入与生活条件统计数据，我们认为负担不成比例地落在了低收入城市租房者身上，他们既面临租金上涨，又面临成为房主前景的缩减。对于财务上更为脆弱的租房者而言尤为如此，自全球金融危机前以来，他们成为房主的概率已下降超过一半。第三，我们提供了新的实证证据，表明业主与租户之间收入及财富差距的扩大，因劳动力流动性降低带来的效率成本而进一步加剧，因为高昂的住房成本使得工人更难迁移至生产力更高的地区——从数量上看，过去十年间，住房可负担性约束可能导致欧盟内部约一百万次潜在迁移未能实现。上述分析为国际货币基金组织2026年欧元区磋商中提出的缓解住房可负担性挑战的政策建议提供了支撑，包括需重点采取国家层面措施以增加住房供给，同时欧盟层面的行动发挥补充作用。
authors: Robert C. M. Beyer & Nina Biljanovska & Alexandra Fotiou & Morgan Maneely & Mr. Frederik G Toscani

title: Locked Out: Drivers and Economic Implications of Declining Housing Affordability in Europe
title_zh: 被拒之门外：欧洲住房可负担性下降的驱动因素与经济影响

abstract: In the pandemic era, people moved from high-density, expensive areas to more affordable areas, putting upward pressure on local housing prices. We examine the geographic distribution of rent growth during this time and its effects on renters. We use administrative new lease data from RealPage and household-level data on rent and income from the American Community Survey. We analyze rents and incomes using Public Use Microdata Areas grouped in two ways: by prepandemic rent levels and by pre-pandemic rent-to-income ratios. Rents grew more in areas with lower pre-pandemic rents but not in areas with lower rent-to-income ratios, consistent with higher-income remote workers moving away from high rent areas to more affordable areas. Lower-income households experienced larger increases in rent relative to their income compared to the median renter. However, area-level rent-to-income ratios reflect both compositional changes in renter populations from mobility and changes in local rents. We highlight the need for future work to track affordability for the same households over time to fully understand pandemic era affordability trends.
abstract_zh: 在疫情时代，人们从高密度、昂贵地区迁移至更为经济实惠的区域，对当地房价产生了上行压力。我们考察了这一时期租金增长的地理分布及其对租房者的影响。我们利用RealPage提供的行政新租赁数据以及美国社区调查中关于租金和收入的家庭层面数据，通过两种方式对公共使用微观数据区域进行分组分析：一是依据疫情前租金水平，二是依据疫情前租金收入比。结果显示，疫情前租金较低的地区租金增长更快，但租金收入比较低的地区并未出现此现象，这与高收入远程工作者从高租金地区向更可负担地区迁移的趋势相符。相较于中等收入租房者，低收入家庭经历了与其收入相比更大的租金涨幅。然而，区域层面的租金收入比既反映了因流动性导致的租房人口构成变化，也反映了当地租金的变动。我们强调，未来研究需追踪同一家庭随时间变化的负担能力，以全面理解疫情时代的负担能力趋势。
title: The Flight to Affordability: Effects of Pandemic Rent Increases on Renters By Geography
title_zh: 向可负担性的逃离：疫情租金上涨对不同地区租房者的影响
